a.lede: The name change is enough for Germany's transport minister to start advocating for Europe-wide adoption of the driver assistance software.
a.title: Tesla renames ‘Full Self-Driving’ to ‘Tesla Assisted Driving’ in Europe

b.lede: The automaker has been criticized for misleading drivers with the feature’s name. Now it’s renaming it for European regulators.
b.title: Tesla’s ‘Full Self-Driving’ Becomes ‘Assisted Driving’ in Europe
